panels.title: cgroup scrapes skipped (rate, last 5m)
panels.description: Per-scrape count of groups whose cgroup metrics were dropped because their procs span multiple cgroups. This is a CUMULATIVE COUNTER, so it is shown as increase()[5m] (groups skipped in the last 5 min) — the raw counter only ever grows. A non-zero value is expected for genuinely split groups (e.g. csi-node-driver, whose procs live in different cgroups); a rising rate for other groups means investigate.

panels.title: CPU usage rate (cpu.stat) by group
panels.description: rate of cpu_seconds_total across user+system, in cores.

panels.title: CPU usage rate by mode (user/system) — sum of selected groups
Node CPU pressure — waiting (some)
panels.description: Whole-node PSI from node_exporter (node_pressure_*). CPU has no 'full' state. Fraction of wall-clock time at least one task was stalled waiting for CPU. Compare against the per-cgroup CPU pressure above to see whether contention is node-wide or group-local.

panels.title: Node Memory pressure — waiting (some) & stalled (full)
panels.description: Whole-node memory PSI from node_exporter. some = any task stalled on memory; full = all non-idle tasks stalled (strong node-wide OOM / thrash signal).

panels.title: Node IO pressure — waiting (some) & stalled (full)
panels.description: Whole-node IO PSI from node_exporter. some = any task stalled on IO; full = all non-idle tasks stalled. Sustained full IO pressure indicates the node's disk/EBS is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Cgroup memory.current vs Process RSS (per group)
panels.description: Whole-cgroup memory (memory.current, solid) vs the sum of matched process RSS (dashed). The gap is page cache / kernel memory / unmatched procs in the cgroup. cgroup >= process-sum is expected.

panels.title: Cgroup Swap vs Process Swap (per group)
panels.description: Whole-cgroup swap (memory.swap.current, solid) vs summed per-process swap (memory_bytes{memtype=swapped}, dashed). Like the RSS overlay: cgroup counts the whole cgroup once; process-sum is matched PIDs only.

panels.title: memory.stat fields by group
panels.description: Selected memory.stat fields (anon/file/slab/sock per the config allowlist).

panels.title: CPU pressure — waiting (some)
panels.description: Fraction of wall time procs in the cgroup were stalled waiting on CPU. rate() of the seconds counter ≈ stalled-seconds per second.

panels.title: Memory pressure — waiting (some) & stalled (full)
panels.description: waiting = PSI some (any proc stalled); stalled = PSI full (all procs stalled). Full memory pressure is a strong OOM / thrash signal.

panels.title: Kernel PSI avg10 — waiting (some) & stalled (full), all resources (percent, 10s window)
panels.description: namedprocess_namegroup_cgroup_pressure_percent, window=avg10. Kernel-computed averages — no rate() needed.

targets.expr: avg by (groupname, resource, kind) (namedprocess_namegroup_cgroup_pressure_percent{node=~"$node", groupname=~"$group", window="avg10"})

panels.title: NMA GC Rate & Heap Alloc Rate
IO operations rate (io.stat rios/wios) by group & device
panels.description: Per-cgroup IOPS: rate of io_ops_total split by iomode. device is MAJ:MIN, resolved to the kernel disk name via node_disk_info (e.g. nvme0n1 = root EBS). This is the per-cgroup analog of EBS VolumeReadOps/VolumeWriteOps.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(sum by (node, groupname, device, iomode) (rate(namedprocess_namegroup_cgroup_io_ops_total{node=~"$node", groupname=~"$group", iomode=~"read|write"}[5m])), "major", "$1", "device", "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)"), "minor", "$2", "device", "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)")
* on (node, major, minor) group_left(diskname)
label_replace(node_disk_info{node=~"$node"}, "diskname", "$1", "device", "(.*)")

panels.title: IO throughput rate (io.stat rbytes/wbytes) by group & device
panels.description: Per-cgroup disk throughput: rate of io_bytes_total split by iomode. device MAJ:MIN resolved to kernel disk name via node_disk_info. Analog of EBS VolumeReadBytes/VolumeWriteBytes.

targets.expr:
label_replace(label_replace(sum by (node, groupname, device, iomode) (rate(namedprocess_namegroup_cgroup_io_bytes_total{node=~"$node", groupname=~"$group", iomode=~"read|write"}[5m])), "major", "$1", "device", "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)"), "minor", "$2", "device", "([0-9]+):([0-9]+)")
* on (node, major, minor) group_left(diskname)
label_replace(node_disk_info{node=~"$node"}, "diskname", "$1", "device", "(.*)")

panels.title: PID/thread exhaustion events (pids.events max)
panels.description: rate of fork/clone rejections caused by hitting pids.max. Non-zero = the cgroup ran out of its task (process+thread) allotment — the NMA SIGABRT signature.

panels.title: Task saturation — current & peak vs limit (pids.current/peak ÷ pids.max)
panels.description: How close each cgroup is to its pids.max task limit. peak/max surviving near 1.0 after an incident is the fingerprint of a limit-hit crash.

panels.title: Tasks: current / peak / limit (pids.current/peak/max)
panels.description: Absolute task counts and the limit per cgroup. peak is the high-water mark and survives after current recedes.
